Kahlua
By: Michelle La Clair
Published: Wednesday, February 24, 2010 - 9:18am

Ingredients




6 cups sugar
4 cups water
1/4 cup instant coffee granules
2 cups water
1/4 th of vodka
1/2 cup vanilla extract

Preparation

1 Combine the sugar and 4 cups water. Boil for 10 minutes. Set aside. 2 Combine coffee and 2 cups water. Boil for 8 minutes. Add to sugar water. 3 Let sit until room temperature. 4 Add vodka and vanilla to coffee mixture. Refrigerate.
